Container.Name: tududi-executor
Container.Overview: Tag-triggered agentic execution for tududi. Polls tududi for tasks tagged execute-me that already carry a completed plan (plan:done), hands the plan to a bounded Ollama tool-calling agent that works inside a persistent git workspace clone, and commits its changes to a bridge/exec-* branch you review in code-server. Runs alongside the tududi-ingest, tududi-worker, and tududi-planner containers from the same tududi-bridge image family.

Config.Name: Data Dir
Config.Description: Durable queue DB (shared) plus this container's local repo clone cache

Config.Name: Workspace Dir
Config.Description: Persistent git workspace clones the agent works in. Must ALSO be mounted into code-server at codeserver.workspace_container_root (config.yml) -- same host path, two containers.

Config.Name: Prompts Dir
Config.Description: Prompt templates -- bind-mounted so edits take effect on container restart, no rebuild needed

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Lets the docker sandbox backend `docker exec` into your code-server container. Grants root-equivalent host access -- omit only if codeserver.exec_backend is set to local in config.yml.

Config.Name: Mac SSH Key
Config.Description: Private key for SSH access to the Mac configured under mac.ssh_key in config.yml. Only needed if mac.enabled is true and mac.projects lists a project that needs it. Leave blank otherwise.

Config.Name: GitHub Token
Config.Description: Read-only, fine-grained personal access token used to clone/push project repos. Push only happens if executor.allow_push is also set true in config.yml.
